sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NSIDC L81 names Larsen divisions A-D; L91/L101 specifically gives Larsen A1995 disintegration and L96/L113 Larsen B2002 rapid collapse. L78 places them at Antarctic Peninsula. These exact section/event labels uniquely identify Larsen, not just any shelf that calves. BAS/AAP/NASA place the other three real Antarctic shelves in distinct named regions, making all labels credible but only index3 correct.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это шельфовый ледник Ларсена. Потепление воздуха способствовало распаду его северных частей.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: First sentence explicitly names Larsen. NSIDC L86 says exceptionally warm summers drove northern Larsen breakup; L87-L88 explains surface melt ponds and other pressures contributed. Russian contributed preserves limited causation, without claiming air temperature was the only cause or all Larsen disappeared.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шельфовый ледник Фильхнера — Ронне занимает южную часть моря Уэдделла.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: BAS L152 explicitly locates Ronne/Filchner shelf at the southern end of Weddell Sea. Current note says occupies southern part, not a numerical majority, not a split by Berkner, and not A/B collapse. This is a concrete own-location fact for Filchner–Ronne.

sourcesLocators.locator: BAS complete Berkner context L139-L155, especially L152

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шельфовый ледник Эймери расположен в заливе Прюдс в Восточной Антарктиде.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: AAP L316 calls Amery an East Antarctic embayed shelf and L317 places its front’s iceberg discharge directly into Prydz Bay. That physical front-to-bay relationship supports the note’s Amery-in-Prydz description; NASA L267 independently confirms East Antarctica. It does not say all Prydz Bay is filled or use dated calving predictions.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шельфовый ледник Гетца тянется вдоль побережья Земли Мэри Бэрд.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NASA Getz article L261-L268 describes the Marie Byrd Land coastal sector and the full650-km Getz grounding-line margin. The note accurately identifies that coastal shelf; no study-period retreat quantity or rate is imported.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Шельфовый ледник Ларсена тянется вдоль восточного берега Антарктического полуострова и граничит с морем Уэдделла.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NSIDC L78 literally places Larsen along eastern Antarctic Peninsula and bordering Weddell Sea in present tense. L81-L82 distinguishes remaining sections from disintegrated embayments. The note supplies east-side/Weddell geography beyond the prompt’s generic peninsula/A-B-collapse clue; it claims neither A/B restoration nor unchanged pre-collapse area.

absoluteLevel.ground: Recognizing Larsen from widely reported A/B ice-shelf collapses requires thematic polar geography/science-news familiarity. It is not a universal broad-adult fact, but it asks neither dates, fracture physics nor specialist quantitative parameters. A knowledgeable thematic adult can recognize it among four real shelves; an outsider can at best use regional familiarity to narrow the choice.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Larsen extends on the eastern side of Antarctic Peninsula and borders Weddell Sea.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondWholePromptAndKey: The prompt/key identifies a shelf through A/B collapse near the peninsula; neither gives eastern side or the bordering sea. These are additional concrete geographical attributes of Larsen itself.

taxonomy.ground: Approved polar nature and physical geography: named Antarctic shelf and its historical physical changes. It does not become an expedition-history or general climate-theory question merely because warming is explained afterward.
